messages:
Priya K.: Quick proposal: run a focused marketplace sandbox test with 2 ISVs + 1 hardware partner to validate install flow, billing propagation, and orchestration paths (LangChain + LlamaIndex). Aim for a lightweight public demo after we clear legal.
Omar L.: Sounds good. Which ISVs and HW partner?
Priya K.: ISVs: AtlasQA and DocWeave. HW: AsterCompute (they provide an adapter for our gateway).
Jin W.: +1. We should test AWS Marketplace listing install (single-click), GCP marketplace, and manual helm fallback. Exercise SSO (OIDC) and service-account flows.
Nora S.: I'll own the marketplace install checklist. Items: agreement flow, metering token exchange, role grants, and webhook for provisioning success.
Ben T.: For metering we need adapter to emit `x-rw-org-id` + `x-rw-billing-tokens` in install callback. Partners must map these into their provisioning payload.
Omar L.: Tech test matrix: 1) LangChain runner tool call -> gateway adapter -> model, 2) LlamaIndex sync (cold index) -> query, 3) model fallback to smaller quantized variant, 4) billing event recorded in usage store.
Jin W.: Add perf gates: median p50 < 600ms for simple queries, p95 < 1.8s on dedicated staging. Also verify KV cache hit rate after second query > 70%.
Priya K.: Good. Timeline: partner onboarding + perms by Thu, infra & repo setup Fri, smoke runs next Mon, taped demo Wed. Legal/marketing window 7 days after sign-off.
Nora S.: Partners asked for a sandbox NDA. We can use the short form; I'll circulate.
Ben T.: Need to update the marketplace install webhook to accept `vendor_install_id` and `metering_callback_url`. I'll open an infra ticket.
Omar L.: Repo layout suggestion: `/marketplace/`, `/helm/`, `/adapters/aster/`, `/e2e/` with `run_smoke.sh`. Example: `./e2e/run_smoke.sh --provider aws --check-metrics`.
Jin W.: For orchestration sample, include LangChain YAML and a small orchestrator snippet:```
# orch.yaml
pipeline:
  - name: ask
    type: langchain
    config:
      runner: http://localhost:8080/run
      tools:
        - name: search
          adapter: aster-adapter
```
Nora S.: Also include a LlamaIndex bootstrap script that forces a cold load: `python bootstrap_index.py --drop-kv --seed 100`. We want to see cold-start latency.
Priya K.: Marketing note: partners want to control quotes. Erika is OOO; MarketingBot will start the asset checklist.
MarketingBot: Marketing checklist created: logos, partner quotes, co-branded one-pager, embargo date field. Assigned to Nora S. and Priya K.
Ben T.: Ops caveat: AsterCompute adapter currently doesn't propagate our trace header. We need `x-rw-trace-id` in their adapter header passthrough. Pinged Aster eng.
Omar L.: Add a smoke test for adapter memory safety: launch 5 parallel queries with 1024 token responses to confirm no memory leak. Put in `/e2e/mem_stress.sh`.
Jin W.: For fallback scenario, we'll simulate quota exceeded and auto-route to `small-quant` variant. Make sure logs show `fallback: true` and `reason: quota_exceeded`.
Nora S.: Legal asked for a public demo checklist: partner approval of copy, confirmation of SOW clause on co-marketing, and signed asset release. Expect 4 business days.
Priya K.: Owners: Priya (program + partner comms), Nora (marketplace + legal liaison), Ben (infra & billing hooks), Jin (orchestration & e2e), Omar (staging infra & perf). Can everyone confirm ownership?
Omar L.: Confirmed.
Jin W.: Confirmed.
Nora S.: Confirmed.
Ben T.: Confirmed.
Priya K.: I'll schedule a 30-min dry-run next Mon 09:30 PT and share repo link.
MarketingBot: Calendar event created: "Marketplace Sandbox Demo Dry-run" Mon 09:30 PT 1 attendees: Priya K., Nora S., Ben T., Jin W., Omar L., AtlasQA PM, DocWeave PM, AsterCompute rep. Repo link will be added once ready.
